race.title: Grahame Church Memorial Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: NAN'S CHOICE 's Grade 2 bumper success at Aintree on her first outing for Dan Skelton marks her down as one who could go a long way over hurdles. Princess Day and Connells Cross shaped with promise in the same Chepstow novice on hurdle debut last month and are likely to go well. Nicky Henderson point recruit Royal Response is one to monitor closely in the betting. NAN'S CHOICE (IRE) PRINCESS DAY (IRE) CONNELLS CROSS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Nan's Choice (6/5), Royal Response (4/1), Princess Day (9/2), The Flaggy Shore (7/1), Connells Cross (10/1), Martini Majesty (14/1), Rosie's Honour (20/1), Gaelic Heather (50/1), La Trinite (66/1), Snow Is In The Sky (200/1)
